issues.sym: Check engine light with camshaft and crankshaft correlation codes, a rattle at cold start, rough idle, or less power.
issues.why: The timing chains and guides on this V6 wear and stretch, especially when oil changes are stretched out. Left alone, it can end in major engine damage. GM issued bulletins on diagnosis and updated parts.
issues.next: Do not ignore timing codes. Have the chain checked soon, since a badly stretched chain can skip and wreck the engine. Change oil on time with the correct GM-approved oil.

issues.sym: No reverse, the transmission skips from 2nd to 4th or 6th, revs without moving, or a transmission warning comes on.
issues.why: A wave plate in the six-speed automatic's 3-5-reverse clutch pack can crack. GM offered extended coverage for this repair, but that window has closed.
issues.next: Have a transmission shop confirm the cause. Many units were rebuilt with an updated plate. Do not drive if the transmission is slipping badly or has no reverse.

issues.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall)
issues.sym: A Service Air Bag message or airbag light that may come and go when the front seats move.
issues.why: Wiring for the seat-mounted side airbags can develop high resistance, which can keep the side airbags and belt pretensioners from working. GM recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the dealer repair the wiring. Treat an airbag light as a safety issue.

issues.t: Liftgate struts wear and gate drops (recall)
issues.sym: The liftgate drifts down, will not stay up, or the power motor strains and stops.
issues.why: The gas struts that hold the liftgate up wear out early, so an open gate can drop suddenly. GM recalled vehicles for a fix.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Until it is fixed, do not stand under an open liftgate.

issues.sym: Warm air from the vents, especially the rear, or A/C that cools for a while after a recharge and then fades again.
issues.why: Copper dust from the rear blower motor brushes settles on the aluminum evaporator and corrodes it until it leaks refrigerant. GM's bulletin replaces the evaporator and blower motor with updated parts.
issues.next: Have the system leak-tested instead of just recharging it, and ask about bulletin 16-NA-046 so both parts are replaced together.

issues.sym: No warning signs. The danger shows up only when the airbag deploys in a crash.
issues.why: A manufacturing defect can let the driver airbag inflator burst and throw metal fragments into the cabin. GM recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away and get the free repair as soon as possible.

issues.t: Shift to Park message when already in Park
issues.sym: The dash says to shift to Park even though the shifter is in Park, the SUV may not fully shut off or lock, and the battery can drain.
issues.why: The Park switch in the shifter fails to signal the body computer correctly. GM issued a bulletin with a wiring harness jumper fix.
issues.next: Ask a Chevrolet dealer about bulletin 19-NA-206. Wiggling the shifter is a temporary trick, but get it repaired to avoid a dead battery.

issues.t: Stop/start accumulator bolts missing or loose (recall)
issues.sym: Red transmission fluid dripping under the front, a burning smell, slipping, or a sudden loss of drive.
issues.why: Bolts holding the end cap of the stop/start accumulator on the transmission may be missing or loose, so fluid leaks out. That can cause a loss of drive and raises the risk of fire. GM recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If you see fluid leaking or smell burning fluid, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.sym: A shudder during low-speed shifts or light acceleration, rough or delayed shifts, or a jerk when slowing down.
issues.why: Shudder is usually traced to the torque converter clutch and fluid condition. GM issued bulletins calling for a fluid drain and refill with a cooler flush, and further diagnosis when that does not help.
issues.next: Have a dealer road test it and check for transmission bulletins such as PIP5546. Get it looked at before a shudder turns into torque converter damage.

issues.t: Transmission will not upshift or sticks in 2nd
issues.sym: The SUV stays in a low gear, will not upshift, and may set a check engine light with a P2821 code.
issues.why: A small passage in the transmission valve body spacer plate can be restricted, so the shift pressure does not reach the clutch. GM issued a bulletin for this.
issues.next: Have a dealer read the codes and ask about bulletin PIP5557. Avoid highway driving while it is stuck in a low gear.

issues.sym: Clicking or grinding from the front, the engine revs with no movement, or a sudden loss of drive. The SUV may roll even when in Park.
issues.why: Some transmissions got a wrong-size sun gear, and some left half-shafts were missing a retaining ring. Either can let the shaft disengage, which cuts drive and can defeat Park.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get them done. Until then, always set the parking brake when you park.

issues.sym: Low coolant warnings, coolant drips or a sweet smell, a check engine light, and in bad cases overheating.
issues.why: The quick-connect fittings on the radiator hoses can leak early in the vehicle's life. GM opened a special coverage program for this.
issues.next: Do not keep driving if the temperature climbs or a low coolant warning appears. Ask a Chevrolet dealer about special coverage N262546590.

issues.t: Stalls after remote start or in cold weather
issues.sym: The engine stalls shortly after a remote start, or when shifting into Drive or Reverse on a cold morning, then restarts normally.
issues.why: GM has acknowledged the condition in a preliminary bulletin while it works on a repair.
issues.next: Report it to a Chevrolet dealer so it is on record and ask about bulletin PIP6102. Let the engine settle before shifting, and pull over safely if it stalls in traffic.

issues.t: Ticking from the top of the engine
issues.sym: A steady ticking or tapping from the top of the engine that follows engine speed.
issues.why: Debris from manufacturing can lodge in a hydraulic lash adjuster in the valvetrain so it goes soft and ticks. GM issued a bulletin to replace the soft adjusters and their rocker arms.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the source under warranty and ask about bulletin PIP6101. Avoid high revs until it is repaired.

issues.t: Front seat recliner brackets poorly welded (recall)
issues.sym: A front seatback that feels loose or shifts when you lean back on it.
issues.why: Welds where the recliner pivot attaches to the seat frame may be incomplete, so the seat may not hold an occupant properly in a crash. GM recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the seat repaired promptly. Do not use a seat that feels loose.
